retainedCategories.category: Your permit applications, the permits issued, and the name and address on them
retainedCategories.basis: PD 1096 (National Building Code) and the LGU records schedule. A permit is the evidence that a structure was lawfully authorised, and it has to outlast your account.

retainedCategories.category: The tamper-evident audit trail of actions taken on your applications
retainedCategories.basis: NPC Circular 16-01 accountability. Each entry is hash-linked to the one before it; removing one would break the chain, and a broken chain cannot be told apart from a forged one. This includes an entry recording that your erasure request was carried out.
